summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py adds the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum) with eleven members; botocore/args.py adds the EPRBuiltins import, accepts a None endpoint configuration in _should_set_global_sts_endpoint, and adds ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults; tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with 24 tests. tests/unit/test_args.py passes (59 tests), and related suites (regions, client, endpoint, utils) pass (663 tests). The full unit run has one failure, test_awsrequest.py::test_encodes_unicode_method_line, with a urllib3 FakeSocket settimeout error; I did not confirm it on the baseline, so it is likely environmental. Choices: SDK::Endpoint is keyed with None when absent; FIPS and DualStack use the bridge's private lookups; falsy values become False. black and flake8 are not installed in the venv, so formatting was checked by hand (no added line over 79 columns). Nothing is committed.
